overview: Defender Ops is a multi-cloud security operations platform that ingests AWS, Azure and GCP findings, correlates them into incidents, tracks compliance, and now adds scheduled reporting, PDF export, email delivery and alert notification routing.
features: Scheduled weekly and monthly security reports with on-demand custom date ranges
Branded PDF report export with charts, table of contents and executive summary
Email delivery of reports to configured recipients per report type
Per-provider rate-limit backoff counters on the dashboard
Per-customer access control that gates data and navigation in the UI
Cursor pagination for large alert volumes
Alert rule builder with in-app, email and Microsoft Teams notification routing
Notification deduplication, escalation and a full notification log
